missing.title: That order is not here any more
missing.text: You may have cancelled it, or the link is old. Open it again from your orders.

pickup.title: Pickup
pickup.bringText: {{total}} in cash or bank transfer at the stall

history.title: History
history.note: Every status change is recorded with who made it.

change.title: Change this order
change.until: You can edit quantities, remove items or cancel until {{cutoff}}. After you edit, {{stall}} approves the order again.
change.lockedContact: Cutoff passed at {{cutoff}}. To change it, message the stall.
change.settledContact: This order can no longer be changed. To ask about it, message the stall.
change.cancelFailed: We could not cancel the order. It may be past the cutoff now; reload to see its status.

notify.title: Notifications for this order
notify.text: You were told when it was accepted. You will be told when it is ready, or if the stall has to decline it.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this order?
cancelDialog.text: {{stall}} is told right away and the items go back on sale.

spoilage.title: Report spoiled produce
spoilage.intro: Tell {{stall}} what went wrong with {{name}}. Each item can be reported once, until 2 days after its good-until date.
spoilage.notePlaceholder: Leaves turned black after 2 days in the fridge.
spoilage.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
spoilage.photoTooBig: The photo must be 5 MB or smaller.
spoilage.photoType: Send a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
spoilage.sent: Report sent. The stall can reply, and an admin may review it.
spoilage.failed: We could not send the report.
